name: Western Sheet Metal Inc
old_description: Our advanced technology ensures precise and consistent results for both custom fabrication and standard fittings to deliver top-quality sheet metal products. Trust our cutting-edge equipment for superior HVAC or manufacturing solutions.
about:
Western Sheet Metal Inc. has operated from Salt Lake City, Utah since its founding in 1968. The company provides full-service sheet metal fabrication with a focus on HVAC systems and components, celebrating over 58 years in business as of the current period.

The shop runs custom fabrication, laser cutting, bending, and welding to produce rectangular, spiral, and oval ductwork as well as custom parts for commercial HVAC installations. It also supplies standard HVAC fittings and positions itself as a single-source provider for mechanical contractors, leveraging advanced equipment for precise, consistent results.

Primary customers are commercial mechanical contractors and construction firms such as Okland Construction and J&S Mechanical, which have subcontracted to Western Sheet Metal for decades. The company also serves the automotive sector, per its industry listing, and works to SMACNA standards using a union workforce from SMWIA Local 312.

Western Sheet Metal emphasizes locally sourced materials, competitive pricing, and a partnership approach that integrates with contractors’ teams. Its stated differentiators include adherence to SMACNA standards, a union-trained workforce, and over five decades of HVAC-specific experience.
